title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
summary: Return the smallest length of a nonempty contiguous segment whose sum is at least target.

contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned int.

statement: Return the smallest length of a nonempty contiguous segment whose sum is at least target. Return zero if no such segment exists.

examples.explanation: The segment [3,1,5] reaches the target. No shorter segment does.
The first entry alone reaches the target.
Even the whole array is too small.

hints: Conceptual: All entries are positive, so extending a segment increases its sum.
Directional: Keep a window and shrink it whenever its sum reaches the target.
Implementation: Advance the right endpoint, then repeatedly remove the leftmost value while recording every qualifying length.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
